name: sk-slider
title: Slider
description: A slider that grows under your thumb and ticks haptically as it crosses steps. The track thickens on contact — the same trick that makes the system volume slider feel physical.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKSlider(value: $volume, in: 0...1)
SKSlider(value: $rating, in: 0...10, step: 1) { Text("Rating") }
